descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S10 Existing specs: default model, retry and fallback by error kind, both-fail, and the model recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 The default note model is Claude Haiku 4.5, set in the 'AI provider' table and changeable without a new release. (TFA-94422 AC 1; UAT 3.1)
  • T6 A temporary Haiku failure gets one Haiku retry, then the same call goes to Mistral; a non-temporary Haiku failure goes straight to Mistral. … (TFA-94422 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 3; UAT OAT-03)
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option). (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Tim's api specs with bedrock.invoke stubbed per model

When Run the specs by title

Then Default is Bedrock Haiku 4.5 and the table row can make Mistral primary. Throttle then throttle → Haiku, Haiku, Mistral; throttle then answer → Haiku twice, no Mistral; a refused request → Mistral at once, no second Haiku; an unclassified error → Mistral at once; both fail → the error is raised after Haiku, Haiku, Mistral. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright verdicts. The deployment-error exception (credentials, access, guardrail) thrown without Mistral is Q12. The build skips the Haiku retry when a temporary failure took 10 s or more (unit test RT-07, not in these api specs), which AC 2 does not mention: Q22. Whether the UI then shows a clear error is S08

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S10

Existing specs:

  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers (twin): a Haiku throttle is retried on Haiku once, then answered by Mistral — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers (twin): the second Haiku try can answer — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-02 a request Haiku refuses goes straight to Mistral, with no second Haiku try — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-02 an unclassified error is not temporary: Mistral at once — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-04 both fail — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-05 row controls primary (twin): Mistral primary with a Haiku fallback — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-01 log shows the answering model — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-02 audit row shows it too — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — defaults text generation to Bedrock with Claude Haiku 4.5 — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api specs): bedrock.invoke is stubbed per model in-process and the aiCallLog / audit rows are read on the local stack; dev has no admin key and no stub, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
